_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper. Proposes 'PLRC' (Phase-Shift Laser Ranging with Communication) combining Phase-Shift Ranging and Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum (DSSS) Communication.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: PLRC system schematic (LiDAR Transceiver + Comm Receiver). Fig 3: Experimental setup (Fiber-based ranging emulation). Fig 4: Range accuracy linear fit. Fig 9: Comparison with SSS.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: FSO-ISAC (LiDAR + Comm). Waveform: RF Subcarrier with Phase Coding (DPSK + DSSS/m-sequence). Sensing: Phase-Shift measurement (fine) + Correlation (coarse/ambiguity resolution). Comm: Spread Spectrum decoding.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Ranging Precision: 3.54 mm (experimental). Comm Rate: 1.43 Mbps. Unambiguous Range: 105m (theoretical).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Addresses the 'contradiction' between phase utilization for ranging (needs continuity) and communication (needs modulation). Uses PRN code correlation to resolve the integer phase ambiguity, allowing high-frequency subcarrier for precision.

bibliographic.title: Remote Phase-Shift LiDAR With Communication
bibliographic.authors: Yalong Hai, Yufei Luo, Chenxu Liu, Anhong Dang

application.scenario_description: LiDAR system measuring distance to a target that also houses a communication receiver (nested receiver).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Proposed PLRC (Phase-Shift Laser Ranging with Communication) scheme. Combines phase-shift ranging (for precision) with PRN code correlation (for ambiguity resolution and comms). Optimization of power allocation.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Trade-off between ranging precision and unambiguous range in phase-shift LiDAR, and the integration of communication without degrading ranging performance.

transmitter.notes: 1550 nm laser. Intensity Modulated with RF Subcarrier (10 MHz). Subcarrier is Phase Modulated (DPSK) with Spread Spectrum Code (m-sequence).

waveform.notes: Unified: Phase-Coded Subcarrier. Ranging uses Subcarrier Phase + Code Correlation. Comm uses Code Despreading.

channel_fibre.notes: Fiber used to emulate free space delay (up to 73.6m optical path).

tradeoff.notes: Optimal power split derived for Sensing vs Comm. Ranging precision vs Comm Rate trade-off managed via Code/Subcarrier parameters.
